value.text: Check the weather in Rome for the next day and tell me what to wear.

arguments.answer: Tomorrow in Rome will be sunny with a high of 21°C. Wear light, breathable layers like a t-shirt and light trousers, and bring a light jacket for the cooler morning and evening. Sunglasses and sunscreen are a good idea too.
